description: This file defines the interface DeleteAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder, which provides methods to build responses and events for delete attribute commands within a live signals command framework. It includes nested interfaces for response and event factories, allowing the creation of success responses, error responses, and deletion events related to delete attribute commands.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building command responses and events for DeleteAttribute commands, extending the modify command response step with specific factories.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating response objects related to DeleteAttribute commands, including success and error responses.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects triggered by DeleteAttribute commands, specifically the AttributeDeleted event.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a DeleteAttributeResponse indicating successful deletion.

methods.name: attributeNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse indicating the attribute was not accessible.

methods.name: attributeNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse indicating the attribute was not modifiable.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates an AttributeDeleted event indicating an attribute was deleted.
